SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.out_order_no AS outOrderId, COALESCE(CAST(ca.channel_id AS CHAR), '0') AS channelId, COALESCE( ca.channel_name, CASE WHEN om.source_type = 'frontdesk' THEN '自来客' WHEN om.source_type = 'phone' THEN '电话订单' ELSE '自来客' END ) AS channelName, COALESCE( ca.channel_name, CASE WHEN om.source_type = 'frontdesk' THEN '自来客' WHEN om.source_type = 'phone' THEN '电话订单' ELSE '自来客' END ) AS orderChannelName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, CAST(om.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, CAST(om.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, om.status AS status, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, CAST(om.payment_way_id AS CHAR) AS paymentWayId, om.source_type AS sourceType, om.total_price_cent AS totalPriceCent, om.total_pay_price_cent AS totalPayPriceCent, om.refund_price_cent AS refundPriceCent, COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS commissionPriceCent, gm.selling_price_cent AS sellingPriceCent, om.settlement_amount_cent AS settlementAmountCent, COALESCE(om.day_num, 1) AS count, gm.room_category_type AS roomCategoryType, CAST(gm.category_id AS CHAR) AS categoryId, gm.category_name AS categoryName, pw.payment_way_name AS paymentWayName, COALESCE(om.out_order_no, om.order_no) AS confirmNo, om.created_at AS createdAt, om.updated_at AS updatedAt, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, poi.poi_name AS poiName, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(gm.name, '全天房') AS roomCategoryProductName, r.room_name AS roomName FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN distribution_order do ON do.source_order_id = om.order_id AND do.camp_id = om.camp_id AND do.channel_id = om.channel_id LEFT JOIN pms_poi poi ON poi.poi_id = om.poi_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id LEFT JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.camp_id = om.camp_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = om.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = om.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0
AND ( CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.out_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR gm.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.room_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR poi.poi_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ca.channel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY om.created_at DESC, om.order_id DESC
